intent: The button inside each day cell of a Calendar, carrying the selection state as data attributes and taking focus when keyboard navigation lands on its day.
typical_uses: The inner element of a custom DayButton passed through Calendar's `components`, which adds content or behaviour around the kit's day button

dont_use_when.situation: A button anywhere outside a Calendar's day grid

mounted_in.container: a custom DayButton passed as `components={{ DayButton }}` to Calendar, which receives the library's day button props and forwards them
mounted_in.note: Calendar already renders CalendarDayButton for every day once `mode` or `onDayClick` is set; it is rendered by hand only inside such a replacement, with the `day` and `modifiers` the replacement received.

invariants.text: The button carries `data-selected-single` for a selected day outside any range, and `data-range-start`, `data-range-end` and `data-range-middle` for the parts of a range, all derived from `modifiers`; calendar.module.css keys the selection fill on them.
When `modifiers.focused` becomes true the button moves the browser's focus onto itself; this is how arrow-key navigation reaches it.
`day` is read and dropped, never written to the button as an attribute; the ISO date is on the surrounding cell's `data-day`.

anti_patterns.dont: Render CalendarDayButton without the `day` and `modifiers` a DayButton slot receives
anti_patterns.do_instead: Forward every prop the replacement DayButton received, so the selection attributes and focus handling have their source

day.states: day is the library's CalendarDay object for the button's day
day.because: `CalendarDay` is a class instance holding the date, the displayed month and whether the day is outside it; the compiler leaves the named type to tsc.

modifiers.states: modifiers is an object mapping each modifier name to whether it applies to the day, such as selected, focused, range_start or disabled
modifiers.because: `Modifiers` is `Record<string, boolean>` keyed by the library's and the caller's modifier names; the compiler leaves the named type to tsc.

good.title: A replacement DayButton that marks days with events and keeps the kit's button

bad.title: A day button rendered by hand without the slot's props
bad.why: `day` and `modifiers` are required and come from the Calendar's DayButton slot; without `modifiers` the component throws reading `modifiers.focused`.

day.description: TS: CalendarDay. The compiler emits one JSON type per property; this type is left to tsc. day is the library's CalendarDay object for the button's day. `CalendarDay` is a class instance holding the date, the displayed month and whether the day is outside it; the compiler leaves the named type to tsc.

modifiers.description: TS: Modifiers. The compiler emits one JSON type per property; this type is left to tsc. modifiers is an object mapping each modifier name to whether it applies to the day, such as selected, focused, range_start or disabled. `Modifiers` is `Record<string, boolean>` keyed by the library's and the caller's modifier names; the compiler leaves the named type to tsc.
